description: Least-privilege set: open the window, talk to the local backend, and the five native powers the product uses (ROAD_TO_10 4.7) -- each at the narrowest permission that does its job, with no write access to the file system and no command execution. `remote` is the page itself: the shell loads the app from its own loopback server, and Tauri grants IPC to a window's content only by origin.
